answer: Hardware enclave attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by confining each agent to a verified physical processor. Cryptographic quotes generated from an on-chip security vault prove genuine execution to peers. Rather than spawning bots that flash and fade like a comet, an adversary incurs the verifiable cost of procuring dedicated secure silicon per identity. A notable limitation is that unpatched side-channel leaks can turn an older processor into an insecure relic, enabling key theft.
